turns.text: Good morning, Sofia! I hope your Monday is starting off well. How are things looking for your shift at the clinic today? And how is Dash doing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Morning! Dash is doing great, he was his usual lazy self this morning. My day is off to a decent start. I made a quick pot of filtered drip coffee to drink while getting ready, and then I drove my car into work.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A quiet morning with Dash and some fresh coffee sounds like a nice way to ease into the week. How was the drive in? Did you get to listen to anything interesting?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It was a pretty easy drive. Normally I'd put on my usual dog training podcast, but today was an exception—I listened to an audiobook instead, because a friend lent me a copy of one.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, how fun! It's always nice when a friend shares a good recommendation. What kind of book is it? Also, did you manage to pack a good lunch for your shift today?

turns.text: It's a mystery novel, and it's really gripping so far! For lunch, I brought a burrito bowl that I made at home yesterday. I'm actually really looking forward to eating it later.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious and perfect for a busy day. Speaking of busy, how are things going with planning the wedding for this summer? Have you and Tom made any progress lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're making some progress! We've been looking at some local Tucson florists, though we haven't made any final decisions yet. Sourdough baking has actually been a nice way to distract myself from all the wedding stress on the weekends.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I can imagine wedding planning gets overwhelming, so having a hobby like baking is a great outlet. Did you get a chance to bake a fresh loaf this weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I baked a classic country loaf yesterday, and Tom and I have already eaten half of it. It's probably a good thing I have my nursing shifts to keep me busy, or I'd just stay home and bake all day.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It sounds like a delicious distraction! Well, I hope your shift at the outpatient clinic goes smoothly today and that you enjoy your burrito bowl.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm about to head in for my patient rounds now. Talk to you later!
